\documentclass[paper={a5paper},maintitle={Unknown Uppercase Accidentals}]{ulsbs-songbook}
\makeatletter
\newcount\ULtestunknownfactor
\newcommand\ULtestunknownlog[3]{%
  \def\shrp{SHARP}\def\flt{FLAT}%
  \edef\ULtestunknownresult{\the\SB@toks}%
  \typeout{ULUNKNOWN:\ULtestunknownkey:#1:#2:#3:\ULtestunknownresult}}
\newcommand\ULtestunknowncase[2]{%
  \ULtestunknownfactor=-2
  \loop
    \begingroup
    \UL@pdfalternatefalse
    \SB@transposefactor=\ULtestunknownfactor
    \SB@dotranspose{#2}%
    \ULtestunknownlog{source}{\the\ULtestunknownfactor}{#1}%
    \endgroup
    \advance\ULtestunknownfactor by 2
  \ifnum\ULtestunknownfactor<3\repeat
  \ULtestunknownfactor=0
  \loop
    \begingroup
    \UL@pdfalternatetrue
    \UL@pdfspellprepare{\the\ULtestunknownfactor}%
    \SB@dotranspose{#2}%
    \ULtestunknownlog{alternate}{\the\ULtestunknownfactor}{#1}%
    \endgroup
    \begingroup
    \UL@pdfalternatetrue
    \UL@pdfspellprepare{\the\ULtestunknownfactor}%
    % Typography converts canonical input at zero, even after a key hook.
    \SB@transposefactor=0\SB@convertnotestrue
    \notenamesout abcdefg%
    \SB@dotranspose{#2}%
    \ULtestunknownlog{zero}{\the\ULtestunknownfactor}{#1}%
    \endgroup
    \advance\ULtestunknownfactor by 1
  \ifnum\ULtestunknownfactor<12\repeat}
\newcommand\ULtestunknownprobes[1]{%
  \def\ULtestunknownkey{#1}%
  \ULtestunknowncase{CDs}{CD\shrp}%
  \ULtestunknowncase{CDf}{CD\flt}%
  \ULtestunknowncase{NCs}{NC\shrp}%
  \ULtestunknowncase{NCf}{NC\flt}%
  \ULtestunknownfactor=0
  \loop
    \begingroup
    \UL@pdfalternatetrue
    \UL@pdfspellprepare{\the\ULtestunknownfactor}%
    \SB@transposefactor=0\SB@convertnotestrue
    \notenamesout abcdefg%
    \SB@dotranspose{C\shrp}%
    \ULtestunknownlog{zero}{\the\ULtestunknownfactor}{Cs}%
    \endgroup
    \advance\ULtestunknownfactor by 1
  \ifnum\ULtestunknownfactor<12\repeat}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\begin{songs}{}
\beginsong{Known Key Unknown Text}[id={fixture-1},key={C}]
\ULtestunknownprobes{known}
\transpose{2}
\beginverse
\[CD#]KnownSequenceSharp
\[CD&]KnownSequenceFlat
\[NC#]KnownTextSharp
\[NC&]KnownTextFlat
\endverse
\endsong
\beginsong{Missing Key Unknown Text}[id={fixture-2}]
\ULtestunknownprobes{missing}
\transpose{2}
\beginverse
\[CD#]MissingSequenceSharp
\[CD&]MissingSequenceFlat
\[NC#]MissingTextSharp
\[NC&]MissingTextFlat
\endverse
\endsong
\end{songs}
\end{document}
